presets.name: Q版
presets.desc: Q 版大头小身二头身
presets.prompt: Redraw the described subject as an adorable chibi character with about two-head-tall proportions. Preserve the recognizable hairstyle, hair color, eye color, outfit, and accessories; use a big round head, tiny body, sparkling expressive eyes, soft blush, clean bold lineart, bright cel shading, and a simple pastel background with a few small decorative sparkles. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 立绘
presets.prompt: Create a polished full-body anime game character standing illustration (tachie) of the described subject. Show the whole figure from head to toe in a confident natural pose, with detailed costume design, layered fabric folds, refined lineart, high-quality cel shading with soft gradients, rim light, and a clean plain light background suitable for cutting out. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 三视图
presets.prompt: Create a clean character design reference sheet of the described subject showing three full-body views side by side: front, side, and back, all at the same scale with consistent proportions, colors, and costume details. Neutral standing pose, flat even lighting, crisp lineart with light cel shading, plain white background, evenly spaced views, no labels or annotations. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 表情包
presets.desc: 九宫格 Q 版表情
presets.prompt: Create a 3x3 grid sheet of nine chibi reaction stickers of the same described subject, each showing a different exaggerated expression and pose: happy, laughing, crying, angry, shocked, sleepy, shy, thumbs up, and confused. Keep the character design perfectly consistent across all nine, with thick white die-cut outlines, bright flat colors, and a plain light background between cells. Do not add any words or captions. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 赛璐璐
presets.desc: 九十年代复古动画截图
presets.prompt: Render the described subject as a frame from a 1990s Japanese TV anime, hand-painted cel animation style. Use slightly muted retro colors, hard-edged two-tone cel shading, painted watercolor-like backgrounds, subtle film grain, soft analog color bleeding, and a 4:3-era cinematic composition with a warm nostalgic mood. No subtitles. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 浮世绘
presets.prompt: Reimagine the described subject as a traditional Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print. Use bold flowing outlines, flat areas of color in indigo, vermilion, ochre, and soft beige, visible paper fiber and woodgrain texture, stylized waves, clouds, or landscape motifs, and a balanced asymmetric Edo-period composition. No seals, signatures, or calligraphy. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 绘本
presets.prompt: Illustrate the described subject as a page from a warm children's picture book. Use soft gouache and colored-pencil textures, gentle rounded shapes, cozy warm lighting, a whimsical storybook setting with small delightful details, and a calm harmonious palette with plenty of breathing room. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 素描
presets.prompt: Draw the described subject as a refined graphite pencil sketch on textured off-white sketchbook paper. Use confident construction lines, expressive hatching and cross-hatching for shading, soft smudged tones, a few loose unfinished edges, and accurate anatomy and proportions. Monochrome graphite only. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 剪纸
presets.prompt: Transform the described subject into an intricate traditional Chinese red paper-cut artwork. Use a symmetrical or balanced decorative composition with delicate lace-like cutout patterns, auspicious motifs such as clouds, flowers, and waves, solid vermilion red paper with crisp cut edges, and a subtle soft shadow on a warm cream background. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 微缩景观
presets.prompt: Present the described subject as a highly detailed miniature diorama photographed with a tilt-shift lens. Use tiny handcrafted model details, realistic small-scale materials, a shallow band of sharp focus with strong blur at the top and bottom, bright saturated colors, and soft daylight so the whole scene looks like a toy world. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 等距房间
presets.prompt: Create a cute isometric 3D cutaway room scene themed around the described subject. Show a single cube-shaped room with two walls and a floor, filled with charming furniture, props, and personal details that tell the subject's story, soft global illumination, gentle pastel colors, smooth clay-like rendering, and a plain solid background. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 塔罗牌
presets.prompt: Design an ornate tarot card illustration featuring the described subject as the central figure. Use a tall card layout with an elaborate gold Art Nouveau border, symbolic celestial and botanical motifs, rich jewel-tone colors, delicate linework, and a mystical glowing atmosphere. Leave the title area as a blank decorative banner with no letters or numerals. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 彩窗
presets.prompt: Render the described subject as a luminous Gothic stained-glass window. Use bold black lead lines dividing jewel-colored glass pieces, a pointed arch frame, radiant light shining through the glass, subtle glass texture and color variation, and a symmetric sacred-art composition. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 明信片
presets.prompt: Create a vintage travel postcard illustration centered on the described subject. Use a mid-century gouache poster style with simplified shapes, sunny saturated colors, a scenic destination background, a slightly worn paper texture, and a thin cream border. Leave the sky area clean instead of adding lettering. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 写真
presets.prompt: Photograph the described subject as a soft Japanese-style lifestyle portrait. Use natural window light or golden-hour backlight, airy slightly overexposed tones, low contrast, gentle film color, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, a relaxed candid pose, and an everyday setting such as a quiet street, a café, or a seaside. Photorealistic. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}

presets.name: 蒸汽波
presets.prompt: Reimagine the described subject in a vaporwave and synthwave aesthetic. Use a glowing neon pink and cyan palette, a retro sunset with horizontal stripes, a wireframe grid floor, palm trees, classical marble bust motifs, chrome highlights, light VHS scanlines, and a dreamy 1980s retro-futuristic mood. No watermark, logo, signature, or text. Subject: {subject}
